## Referenced by Quarto

With the version v1.1.1, [`quarto-ieee`] is now available on the [quarto-listing] of [quarto-extensions].
To do so, most requirements of [quarto-journal] has been verified.

Moreover, this version also support both ![Tested on Quarto-1.3](https://img.shields.io/badge/quarto-1.3-blue?label=quarto) and ![Tested on Quarto-1.4](https://img.shields.io/badge/quarto-1.4-blue?label=quarto).

You may access a local evaluation of the [`quarto-ieee`] template [in PDF](../quarto-ieee/template.pdf) as well as  [in HTML](../quarto-ieee/template.html).
